test-avinya-whole-body-shield.name: Avinya Whole Body Oncology & Metabolic Assessment

test-comprehensive-cancer-biomarker.description: Blood panel for clinician-directed evaluation and monitoring. Tumor markers may be raised in noncancerous conditions and may be normal when cancer is present. This panel is not a reliable general population cancer screen and does not diagnose or exclude cancer.

test-cancer-psa-prostate.description: Measures prostate-specific antigen. PSA may rise with benign conditions as well as prostate cancer. Discuss the possible benefits and harms of screening with a clinician; PSA alone does not diagnose cancer. Further assessment may be needed.

test-cancer-ca125-ovarian.description: Measures CA-125 for use in appropriate clinical evaluation or monitoring. Noncancerous conditions can raise CA-125, and some cancers do not raise it. It is not a reliable standalone ovarian cancer screen for people without symptoms.

test-cancer-ca19-9-gi.description: Measures CA 19-9 to support clinician-directed evaluation or monitoring. Benign conditions can raise it and some cancers do not. It is not a reliable general population screening test or a standalone cancer diagnosis.

test-tru-pre-operative-profile.description: A listed preoperative laboratory panel. The surgical and anaesthetic team decides which tests are appropriate for the planned procedure and the patient’s health; this panel is not required for every surgery.

test-anemia-profile-basic.description: Measures serum ferritin to support clinician-directed assessment of iron status. Interpret with symptoms and other laboratory findings.

test-vitamin-d3-25oh.description: Measures blood 25-hydroxyvitamin D. This is not a bone density measurement. Ask your clinician how the result should be interpreted.

test-senior-vitality-shield.description: A listed laboratory panel for clinician-directed assessment in older adults. It does not measure bone density or guarantee detection of joint or memory conditions.

test-1.description: Blood panel for clinician-directed evaluation and monitoring. Tumor markers may be raised in noncancerous conditions and may be normal when cancer is present. This panel is not a reliable general population cancer screen and does not diagnose or exclude cancer.

test-2.name: Avinya Whole Body Laboratory Assessment
test-2.description: Laboratory panel for clinician-directed assessment. Tumor markers are not reliable general population cancer screens and do not independently diagnose or exclude cancer.
test-2.tagline: Discuss appropriate testing with your clinician

test-3.description: Circulating DNA testing requires a specific clinical indication and professional interpretation. It is not a guaranteed early cancer diagnosis or a replacement for established evaluation.

test-4.description: Laboratory assessment of listed cardiovascular risk markers. These blood tests do not directly show arterial plaque, diagnose a blockage or guarantee prediction of a stroke.

test-7.name: Senior Citizen Laboratory Assessment
test-7.description: Listed laboratory panel for clinician-directed assessment of older adults. It does not directly measure bone density or diagnose joint degeneration.

test-tru-wellness-women-1.description: Laboratory panel for women covering the listed metabolic, blood count, calcium and thyroid measurements. Blood calcium testing does not measure bone density. Discuss the appropriate tests with your clinician.

test-homa-insulin-resistance.description: Calculation using fasting glucose and insulin measurements to support a clinician’s assessment of insulin resistance. Interpretation depends on the clinical context.
